questions.stem: A 32 y/o pregnant woman presents for her routine antenatal check-up at 28 weeks gestation. She has a history of obesity but no previous history of diabetes. Her fasting plasma glucose level is 104 mg/dL, and her 2-hour plasma glucose level after a 75g Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT) is 167 mg/dL. Based on these findings, what is the most appropriate next step?

options.label: A
options.text: Start lifestyle modifications and repeat OGTT at 32 weeks gestation.

options.label: B
options.text: Diagnose her with pre-existing diabetes and initiate insulin therapy.

options.label: C
options.text: Diagnose her with GDM and initiate dietary modifications with close monitoring of blood glucose levels.

options.label: D
options.text: Monitor her closely without intervention since her glucose levels are borderline.
